result.text: brainspotting as i understand it first of all is something you can do yourself, i've done it myself. it's intuitive and you can automatically figure it out quickly. EMDR is more targeted towards specific memories or traumas with recall procedures etc, while BS you can feel it out and it doesn't require knowing exactly what you're targeting
